map.info.missions.title: Missions
map.info.missions.intro: Missions are plant suggestions to look for within a defined area. They represent observations that would be particularly valuable from a scientific standpoint; missions are created and selected automatically based on the predictions of our models.
map.info.missions.howTitle: Why a plant is a mission
map.info.missions.how1: The model is uncertain whether this plant is present at this location. A new observation would help confirm its presence.
map.info.missions.how2: This plant is rarely observed in the area, or in general. Each additional observation is valuable.
map.info.missions.how3: This plant is characteristic of this location and is rarely, if ever, found elsewhere.
map.info.missions.note: Missions are, by definition, based on uncertainty about a plant's presence at this location. Some may be present but difficult to find, and some may also turn out to be absent.
map.info.around.title: Around me
map.info.around.intro: The plants considered most likely to be found nearby, based on model predictions.
map.info.around.how: The prediction is based on local conditions — climate, season, and terrain — combined with satellite imagery, compared against locations where each plant has previously been recorded.
map.info.around.note: This is a prediction, not a confirmed list. Presence can only be verified through direct observation.
